meta.name: google-ads-copy
meta.description: Generate and A/B test Google Ads copy. Use when asked to write ad copy, headlines, descriptions, create ad variants, test ad messaging, improve CTR, or generate RSA (Responsive Search Ad) components. Trigger on "ad copy", "write ads", "headlines", "descriptions", "RSA", "responsive search ad", "ad text", "ad creative", "improve CTR", "ad A/B test", "ad variants", "write me an ad", "ad variation experiment", or when the user wants to improve click-through rate on existing ads.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编写并测试谷歌广告文案,提升点击率
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在谷歌广告上投放,想通过文案测试提高点击率。
copy.tagline_en: Write and A/B test Google Ads copy to boost click-through rates.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Google Ads and want data-backed ad copy tests to lift CTR.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会生成 Google Ads 的 RSA(自适应搜索广告)标题和描述,并设计 A/B 测试。它先核对业务背景与现有广告数据,再输出带字数、固定位置、概念 ID 和声明来源的文案,不编造无依据的卖点。
howto.when: 当你想写谷歌广告文案、标题、描述,创建广告变体或做 A/B 测试,或提到“ad copy”“RSA”“提高 CTR”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我为“紧急水管维修”广告组写 5 条 RSA 标题和 2 条描述。
say.note: 它会先读业务背景和现有广告数据再写。

say.text: 给这个广告做 A/B 测试,比较“专业可靠”和“快速响应”两种文案方向。
say.note: 它会定义测试假设、流量分配和胜负规则。

say.text: 帮我提升现有广告的点击率,先分析广告组数据再给新的变体。
say.note: 它会先看基准数据,确保新文案有依据。

howto.what_en: Generates Google Ads RSA headlines & descriptions and designs A/B tests. It reads business context and ad data first, then outputs complete assets with character counts, pin positions, concept ID, and claim ledger, without fabricating unsupported proof.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to write Google Ads copy, create variants, test messaging, or improve CTR; keywords like 'ad copy', 'RSA', 'headlines' also activate it.

say_en.text: Write 5 RSA headlines and 2 descriptions for the 'Emergency Plumbing Repair' ad group.
say_en.note: It reads business context and existing ad data first.

say_en.text: A/B test our ads: compare 'Trust' vs 'Speed' angles and define the decision rule.
say_en.note: It sets up the test design and success criteria.

say_en.text: Improve CTR on this ad group: analyze data first, then suggest new variants.
say_en.note: It checks baselines and proposes grounded variations.
